metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: FUJIFILM Professional Film Data Guide (US), Ref. No. AF3-207U, (c) 2005 Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., PDF page 34 (spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves, minimum and midscale-neutral spectral density; RMS granularity 7). PDF sha256 64c6455651b9f13f5cd190219e4928d1fdf13ecf33859c4691d830bced8d3d36. Data (c) FUJIFILM Corporation. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/fujifilm-pfdg/fujifilm_superia_1600/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), steps 1-8: D-min removed, log E zero where green is 0.2 over D-min plus 3 stops, dye spectra reconstructed (dmid_dmin) from spektrafilm's generic_a dye set (Giorgianni, Madden & Kriss 2009, p. 112, via spektrafilm) because the datasheet gives no per-dye spectra, status-M unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, midscale alignment 'mid' (of none/green/mid, the lowest grey-ramp neutrality error, none 0.118, green 0.081, mid 0.071, among those whose fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii neutral filters fall in the shipped films' range; outside it: 'none'), densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, and spektrafilm's grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 through fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii at data_trustability 0.3. hanatos2025 adaptation window [404.8, 22.9, 613.0, 54.8] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md.
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; target print fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 1.0 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves in log10 H as printed; use 'still' and antihalation 'weak' as the shipped Fujifilm still negatives (C200, X-TRA 400, Superia 200, Reala 100, Pro 160NS).
Note: the datasheet's dashed 'Cyan Sensitive Layer' (Fujifilm's fourth colour layer) is not modelled: the three-layer model takes the blue, green and red sensitive layers only
Recorded validation exception: the reconstructed dyes reproduce D-mid minus D-min within 0.036 D (worst at 410 nm, the chart's blue edge), over the 0.03 D criterion; the §D3 flat extension made it worse. Weighted per fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii print channel the residual is R/G/B +0.0037, -0.0003, +0.0088 D, within the 0.01 D the method accepts for this case (approved by Noah 2026-11-14).
Relative axes: sensitivity y axis: Relative Sensitivity (log): no tick values, a 1.0 scale bar spans the two gridlines (one log unit). The offset is arbitrary; D5 rescales every channel so it does not reach the profile.
Recorded extraction exceptions: spectral_density x axis, gate 0.3 % of span: hand-drafted grid: no straight axis reproduces the gridlines within 0.2 % (worst 0.21 %, 0.731 nm); the Data Guide reuses the same uneven grid on several spreads. The extraction error is bounded by that residual whether the curves were drawn to the true scale or to the drawn grid. Physical check: X-TRA 400 from this guide matches spektrafilm's independent trace of datasheet AF3-151E within 0.007 D (curves) and 0.016 D (D-min, D-mid). spectral_density y axis, gate 0.5 % of span: hand-drafted grid: no straight axis reproduces the gridlines within 0.2 % (worst 0.41 %, 0.0102 D); the Data Guide reuses the same uneven grid on several spreads. The extraction error is bounded by that residual whether the curves were drawn to the true scale or to the drawn grid. Physical check: X-TRA 400 from this guide matches spektrafilm's independent trace of datasheet AF3-151E within 0.007 D (curves) and 0.016 D (D-min, D-mid).
